filter_note: V1 set (7) + market briefing + AI news; Today window = Tue Oct 27 – Wed Oct 28 PT

market_briefing.lede: CRM work is moving into general-purpose assistants: ServiceNow now lets sellers update deals and build quotes from Gemini Enterprise, and Oracle is bringing its applications into ChatGPT under each customer's permissions and approvals. Slack, meanwhile, is giving agents shared channels for longer jobs instead of private chats.

bullets.text: ServiceNow CRM integrations with Gemini Enterprise are generally available as of Oct 27: sellers can ask for account context and recent deal activity, update opportunity notes, create follow-ups and build configurations and quotes in natural language. ServiceNow connects them through MCP servers and Agent2Agent (A2A).

OpenAI and Oracle said on Oct 27 that Oracle is developing Oracle AI Workspace to run approved Oracle workflows inside ChatGPT. U.S. Oracle customers can now buy the OpenAI API, Codex and ChatGPT Work through Oracle Marketplace with eligible Oracle Universal Credits.

Slack published a build guide for the Slack Code API on Oct 28. Agents can open a code channel from a conversation, post diffs, HTML previews and canvases, and archive the session with a summary. A Salesforce survey of 250 U.S. executives published Oct 27 found 59% see work stall each week because it sits in one person's AI tool.

biggest_ai_news.title: OpenAI reportedly plans to buy Google TPUs
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 27: The Information, cited by Reuters, reports that OpenAI plans to buy Google's AI chips. No terms were disclosed and OpenAI declined to comment. Reuters notes OpenAI said last week it would offer its frontier models through Google Cloud.

biggest_ai_news.title: Anthropic cuts Claude prices 40% for U.S. government buyers, with no minimum spend
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 27 GSA OneGov agreement: 40% off Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government and the Claude API across every purchase route, extended to state, local, tribal and territorial governments, with consumption-based billing. Anthropic says about 500 U.S. government organizations use Claude and estimates $1B in savings.

biggest_ai_news.title: NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 and Vera CPUs generally available on Oracle Cloud
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 27: OCI made Vera Rubin NVL72 systems and Vera CPUs generally available and plans multi-gigawatt Vera Rubin superclusters. The HGX Rubin NVL8 configuration was announced but is not yet GA.

biggest_ai_news.title: Google DeepMind unveils Genie 4 world model
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 27: a real-time interactive world model that generates audio and dialogue natively and can be steered with natural-language prompts. It is a research preview for trusted testers; Google AI Ultra subscribers and early Gemini API partners get access later.

what_changed.title: ServiceNow CRM actions go live inside Gemini Enterprise
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Oct 27: ServiceNow CRM, ITSM/ITOM and Retail Operations integrations with Gemini Enterprise are GA. Sellers can manage deals, update opportunity notes and create quotes in Gemini. Telecom integrations are expected in early 2027. Connectors will also be published as plugins in Google Cloud Marketplace.

what_changed.title: OpenAI and Oracle bring Oracle apps into ChatGPT
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Oct 27: Oracle AI Workspace (in development) will run Oracle finance, procurement and planning workflows inside ChatGPT. Oracle also announced an AI Security Mesh, an SMB bundle with ChatGPT Business and Codex, and App Composer for Codex-built apps. Oracle reports 130,000 active ChatGPT users and 95,000+ active Codex users internally.

what_changed.title: Slack documents the Slack Code API for agent work channels
what_changed.body: NEW. Oct 28: Slack published a guide showing how agents create code channels, set status, publish diff/HTML/Block Kit/canvas views and archive sessions (code_channels:manage scope). Slack Code is live for Claude, Devin, GitHub Copilot and Vercel integrations, with OpenAI to follow.

what_changed.title: Salesforce survey: executives say work stalls in single-player AI tools
what_changed.body: NEW. Oct 27: in a survey of 250 U.S. executives, 59% say work stalls weekly because it is stuck in one person's AI tool (73% at enterprises vs 37% at SMBs), and 15% say their agents work across multiple systems. Respondents estimate employees lose 3.6 hours a week switching between AI and other apps. Vendor-run survey.

quiet_note: Covered Oct 27 and still in window: Salesforce Agent Fabric cost controls and kill switch, Salesloft Agentic Playbook early access, Clay auto-mode default, Nooks 2,000 customers. No new Gong, Clay, Nooks, Outreach, Salesloft or Monaco launches found for Oct 27–28 beyond those.

watch.title: Salesloft Behind Every Win summit (Nov 4) and Salesforce Agent Evals beta (November)
watch.body: Watch whether Salesloft gives Agentic Playbook pricing or a GA date on Nov 4, and whether Salesforce answers ServiceNow's Gemini Enterprise CRM integration with more Agentforce actions inside third-party assistants as Agent Evals enters beta.

interpretation.fact: ServiceNow made CRM, IT and retail integrations with Gemini Enterprise GA on Oct 27, connected via MCP and A2A. OpenAI and Oracle announced Oracle AI Workspace (in development) for ChatGPT and OpenAI purchases through Oracle Marketplace on Oct 27. Slack published a Slack Code API build guide on Oct 28. Salesforce published a 250-executive survey on Oct 27 (59% see weekly stalls in single-person AI tools). Reuters reported on Oct 27 that OpenAI plans to buy Google TPUs, citing The Information. Anthropic and GSA announced a 40% Claude discount with no minimum commitment on Oct 27. NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 went GA on OCI and Google DeepMind unveiled Genie 4 on Oct 27.
interpretation.note: Light interpretation: none of the watchlist vendors shipped anything new on Oct 28. The new signal is adjacent: CRM vendors are exposing seller actions to Gemini and ChatGPT, so the assistant a buyer already uses is becoming a place where deal work gets done.

feed.summary: Clay makes auto-mode the default for new Claygent columns; it picks a model per row and is 47% cheaper than always using the most capable model.
Salesforce posts its Oct 27 Agent Fabric update: Agent Evals, API Evals and cost controls.
